method.objective: unchanged squared ranking hinge + squared tie gaps + ridge
method.validation: 5 outer grouped folds x 5 seeds, inner 3 grouped folds; same selection grids and seeds. Compare newly trained v3-evidence control vs v4-evidence candidate on IDENTICAL outer test families. Saved model coefficients are never edited.
method.limits: Repeated nonrandom evidence, no pristine holdout. Weak monotonicity; soft tie penalty does not ensure exact price equality. Rechecks never add independent weight.
